AC3 as I froze it required removing --text. That would break nine call sites in the operator's own live prototype scripts (echolet-try.sh and the depr peer wrapper), which is outside this wave's authority and contradicts the design it implements. AC3 now requires the stdin path and a clean console argv, keeps --text, and records its retirement as an open decision for the user. No confirmations existed to void.
